items.expected: Ala3 cannot be characterized fairly by lowest electronic energy alone: a thermochemical 450 K ensemble and barrier-limited jet relaxation can leave several bent conformer motifs relevant.

items.expected: The computed populations and barrier cutoff are model-dependent and do not by themselves prove a unique experimental population; spectroscopically similar conformers may remain unresolved.
